# Lab 21.8: Schedule Patching with VM Manager

## What We Are Going to Do
Turn on VM Manager, run a one-off patch job on labelled VMs, schedule monthly patching, and check the OS inventory.

## Steps

1. **Enable VM Manager for the project.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable osconfig.googleapis.com
gcloud compute project-info add-metadata --metadata=enable-osconfig=TRUE</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Create two labelled VMs.** Public Google images already include the OS Config agent.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances create patch-vm-1 patch-vm-2 --zone=us-central1-a \
  --machine-type=e2-micro --image-family=debian-12 --image-project=debian-cloud \
  --labels=env=lab</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Read the OS inventory.** After a few minutes:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute os-config inventories describe patch-vm-1 --location=us-central1-a \
  --format="yaml(osInfo)"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Use `--view=full` to see installed packages and available updates.

4. **Run a patch job now.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute os-config patch-jobs execute \
  --instance-filter-group-labels="env=lab" \
  --display-name="urgent-patch" \
  --reboot-config=default \
  --async
gcloud compute os-config patch-jobs list --limit=5</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Schedule monthly patching.** Create `patch-deployment.yaml`:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • YAML
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">instanceFilter:
  groupLabels:
  - labels:
      env: lab
patchConfig:
  rebootConfig: DEFAULT
recurringSchedule:
  timeZone:
    id: Asia/Kolkata
  timeOfDay:
    hours: 2
  frequency: MONTHLY
  monthly:
    weekDayOfMonth:
      weekOrdinal: 2
      dayOfWeek: TUESDAY
rollout:
  mode: ZONE_BY_ZONE
  disruptionBudget:
    percent: 50</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute os-config patch-deployments create monthly-lab --file=patch-deployment.yaml</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **Check compliance.** Open **Compute Engine → VM Manager → Patch**. The dashboard shows which VMs are up to date and which need patches.

7. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute os-config patch-deployments delete monthly-lab --quiet
gcloud compute instances delete patch-vm-1 patch-vm-2 --zone=us-central1-a --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Patch job | Runs once on matching VMs |
| Patch deployment | Runs every second Tuesday |
| Rollout | Zone by zone, limited disruption |
| Inventory | Packages and pending updates per VM |
